spec.what: Advanced Temporary Fencing's papers photographed by Andrew on 9 Nov 2026 ("Docket time fencing"): red-book hire agreements 36785 (Double Stack) and 36786 (the S08 construction zone), both installed 2 Nov 2026; blue-book collection forms 28605-28640, removals 2-9 Nov 2026; and green-book service notes 24003 (S08 construction zone, 2 Nov), 24004 (Commodore Park, 3 Nov) and 24005 (supply compound, 3 Nov). Every paper read twice at full size and by an independent reader working from the photographs alone. The owner/site supervisor signed every paper on 8 Nov 2026.
